name: Web MIDI
plain: Lets a site send and receive MIDI messages to music gear.
meaning: Exposes the names of connected MIDI ports and live note and control data from keyboards and pads. With sysex it can reconfigure or flash devices.

access.prompt_ui: Permission bubble: use MIDI devices (sysex prompt is stronger)
access.persistence: Per origin; sysex separate from basic

fields.name: data
fields.range: status 0x80 to 0xFF, data bytes 0 to 127; sysex up to device limit

limits.headline: Can send and get notes with music gear, after you allow it
limits.user_action: You tap Connect keyboard and allow MIDI access in the pop up.
can: Listen for notes from your keyboard or controller
Send notes and lights to your music gear
Show a stronger warning before deeper control called sysex
cannot: Use any music gear before you allow it
Change the gear's settings with sysex unless you allow that
Work in Safari or on iPhone
Keep access if you remove the permission
limits.differs: Chrome, Edge and Firefox support it. Safari and iPhone do not.

story.what_it_is: A site can send and receive music signals with your gear.

marketing.name: Web MIDI API
marketing.pitch: MDN says Web MIDI lets web pages connect to and use musical instruments and controllers.

story.for_you: A pop up asks to use your music devices. After you allow it, your keyboard and a page play together.
story.for_makers: Makers build online synths, lessons and studios that act like desktop music software. It cuts install friction for music apps.

use_cases.example: A browser studio records what you play on a MIDI keyboard.
A piano learning site shows which keys you hit.
A rhythm game uses your drum pad.
A live visual artist links controller knobs to a stage show.
A sound design site lets you tweak a hardware synth from a web page.
A site can list your MIDI gear, which adds to a device fingerprint.

technical_bounds: Safari and iOS do not implement it

history.change: Firefox ships Web MIDI behind a site permission add-on prompt
Permission required for all use, not only sysex
